about_the_game: "Chronicles of the Temporal Flow" is a pixel-art turn-based RPG that blends Chinese fantasy elements with xuanhuan (mystical martial arts) themes. Set in an alternate historical world, players assume the role of a young martial artist navigating a realm filled with puzzles and challenges. The game features strategic turn-based combat requiring tactical skill combinations and equipment management to overcome formidable foes in diverse battle environments. Its unique character progression system allows players to cultivate martial arts techniques while shaping their destiny through narrative choices that lead to multiple endings. Presented in nostalgic pixel aesthetics with intricate Chinese-inspired architecture and costumes, the game immerses players in ancient oriental ambiance. With rich side quests, profound world lore, and dynamic combat mechanics, players will embark on an epic journey through sword-clashing duels and heroic legends.

short_description: Chronicles of the Temporal Flow: Eternal Phoenix is a 2D pixel-art turn-based RPG by Tyranno Studio. Set in an alternate Earth, it follows Murong Xuanxiao, a young Divine Clan warrior, on a time-traveling quest for a legendary sword, overcoming countless challenges with his companions.
